title: Moving to a new phone silently leaves workout photos, the profile photo and own exercise pictures behind
what: The backup help says your workouts, routines and body weight are saved and come back on a new phone. The backup page warns only that progress photos stay on this phone. Photos on a workout, the profile photo and the photo or video on an exercise the member made are also never carried to a new phone, and nothing tells the member before they switch. After the move those pictures are simply missing, which reads as lost data and ends up as a support question.
expected: The backup help and the backup page say plainly that all photos and videos (workout photos, progress photos, profile photo, own exercise pictures) stay on the old phone, so a member saves them before switching.
who: members moving to a new phone
how_often: every phone change by a member with photos
fix_line: Add one line to the backup help and the backup page naming every kind of picture that stays on the old phone
